newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian weekly forex demand falls to $62.49 mln.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian weekly forex demand falls to $62.49 mln.

text.p: Nigeria's central bank said on Friday it sold $62.49 million at a rate of 85 naira to the dollar at its weekly auction.
Last week, the bank sold $71.164 million at the same rate.
The drop in demand follows measures by the central bank to check speculative buying of forex by banks. Last week, it directed banks to give details of all forex end-users.
Bankers said the measures were necessary if the government budget for the auction for 1997 was to be adequate.

"If demands continues at the current level, the forex supply budget of $2.7 billion will be exhausted by the end of third quarter 1997," said Abimbola Olashore, executive director of Lead Merchant Bank, at the monthly meeting of the Money Market Association on Thursday.
